SELECT ta.applicant_email1, ta.applicant_email2, CASE WHEN ts.is_send_email_to_source=? THEN CASE WHEN tu.USER_EMAIL is null then ts.source_email ELSE tu.USER_EMAIL END END AS source_email
FROM tp_applicants ta LEFT JOIN tp_users tu ON ( ta.source_id= tu.user_source_id AND ta.user_id=tu.user_id), tp_sources ts WHERE ta.source_id= ts.source_id AND ta.applicant_id=?

SELECT applicant_home_phone, applicant_home_phone_is_invalid, applicant_cell_phone, applicant_cell_phone_is_invalid, applicant_work_phone, applicant_work_phone_is_invalid, CASE WHEN ts.is_send_sms_to_source=? THEN CASE WHEN tu.USER_CELL_PHONE is null then ts.source_mobile ELSE tu.USER_CELL_PHONE END END AS source_mobile FROM tp_applicants ta LEFT JOIN tp_users tu ON ( ta.source_id= tu.user_source_id AND ta.user_id=tu.user_id), tp_sources ts WHERE ta.source_id= ts.source_id AND ta.applicant_id=?
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NAME, concat(USER_FNAME,' ',USER_LNAME) AS name, user_email FROM tp_users WHERE USER_STATUS=? AND USER_SOURCE_ID=?

SELECT tcfv.custom_field_id, tcfv.custom_field_value, tcf.custom_field_name, tcf.custom_field_type, tcf.custom_field_display_name, tcf.custom_field_entity_type, tcf.custom_field_rank FROM tp_custom_field_values_applicant tcfv , tp_custom_fields tcf WHERE tcfv.custom_field_id=tcf.custom_field_id AND tcfv.entity_id=? ORDER BY tcf.custom_field_rank
select ts.source_cv_limit from tp_sources ts where ts.source_id=?
SELECT source_id FROM tp_sources WHERE source_title = ?

SELECT TBL.user_name, GROUP_CONCAT(TBL.feedback SEPARATOR '
') AS feedback FROM ( SELECT taspt.process_id, taspt.feedback_form_field_id, taspt.trait_comment, taspt.user_id, taspt.rating_field_id, CONCAT(tu.USER_FNAME, ' ', tu.USER_LNAME) AS user_name, tff.feedback_field_title, trf.rating_field_desc, IF((trf.rating_field_desc IS NULL || trf.rating_field_desc = '') AND (taspt.trait_comment IS NULL || taspt.trait_comment = ''), '', CONCAT('
  ', tff.feedback_field_title, IF(IFNULL(trf.rating_field_desc, 1), '', CONCAT('
   ', 'Rating : ', trf.rating_field_desc)), IF(IFNULL(taspt.trait_comment, 1) OR taspt.trait_comment = '', '', CONCAT('
   ', 'Comment : ', taspt.trait_comment)))) AS feedback FROM tp_applicant_selection_process_traits taspt LEFT JOIN tp_users tu ON (tu.USER_ID = taspt.user_id) LEFT JOIN tp_feedback_form_fields tfff ON (tfff.feedback_form_field_id = taspt.feedback_form_field_id) LEFT JOIN tp_rating_fields trf ON (trf.rating_field_id = taspt.rating_field_id) LEFT JOIN tp_feedback_fields tff ON (tff.feedback_field_id = tfff.feedback_field_id) WHERE process_id = ( SELECT process_id FROM tp_applicant_selection_process WHERE process_id > ( SELECT process_id FROM tp_applicant_selection_process WHERE applicant_id = ? AND position_step_id_to = ? AND position_id = ? ORDER BY process_id DESC LIMIT 0,1 ) AND applicant_id = ? ) ORDER BY user_name, tff.feedback_field_title ) TBL GROUP BY TBL.user_id
INSERT INTO tp_browser_import_session_documents (session_id, document_path, file_name, comment_url, date_created) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())
SELECT document_id, document_path, file_name FROM tp_browser_import_session_documents WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY date_created
UPDATE tp_browser_import_session_documents SET import_status = ? WHERE session_id = ?

SELECT CONCAT(REPLACE(tbisd.comment_url, ';', '&'), ?, " ", ?, " on ", date_format(ta.applicant_date_created, '%d-%b-%y'), " at ", date_format(ta.applicant_date_created, '%h:%i %p')) as commentUrl FROM tp_browser_import_session_documents tbisd, tp_applicants ta WHERE ta.applicant_id = ? AND tbisd.session_id= ? AND tbisd.comment_url IS NOT NULL AND tbisd.comment_url != ''
UPDATE tp_applicants SET is_confidential=? WHERE applicant_id=?
SELECT applicant_step_id FROM tp_applicants WHERE applicant_id=?

SELECT ta.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_city, ta.applicant_email1, ta.applicant_email2, ta.applicant_home_phone, ta.applicant_cell_phone, ta.applicant_work_phone, ta.applicant_working_since, ta.applicant_date_joined, ta.applicant_current_employer, ta.current_ctc, ta.expected_ctc, ta.applicant_level_offered, ta.applicant_designation_offered, ta.offered_ctc, ta.offered_basic, ta.input_salary_variable, ta.applicant_position_id, tp.position_code,tp.position_title, ta.employee_code,ta.applicant_hrms_code, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tl.location_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS location_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tsk.skill SEPARATOR ', ') AS applicant_skills, CONCAT(YEAR(FROM_DAYS(DATEDIFF(CURDATE() , ta.applicant_working_since))),' ','yrs',' ', MONTH(FROM_DAYS(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ta.applicant_working_since))),' ','mos') AS applicant_experience, tp.position_note,tp.position_level, td.dept_name, tsd.dept_name as sub_dept_name, tssd.dept_name as sub_sub_dept_name, tbb.band_name,tbg.grade_name, ta.source_id, ts.source_title, now() AS today_date, (select inbox_display_name from tp_inbox_settings) as company_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tbu.bu_name) AS bu_name, tst.source_type, tst.source_type_category, ta.applicant_date_created FROM tp_applicants ta LEFT JOIN tp_applicant_skills tas ON (tas.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id) LEFT JOIN tp_skills tsk ON (tsk.skill_id=tas.skill_id) LEFT JOIN tp_positions tp ON (ta.applicant_position_id = tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments td ON (td.dept_id = tp.dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tsd ON (tsd.dept_id = tp.sub_dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tssd ON (tssd.dept_id = tp.sub_sub_dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_sources ts ON (ts.source_id = ta.source_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_locations tpl ON (tpl.position_id = tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_location_ap tl ON (tl.location_id = tpl.location_id) LEFT JOIN tp_budget_bands tbb ON (tbb.band_id = tp.band_id) LEFT JOIN tp_budget_grades tbg ON (tbg.grade_id = tp.grade_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_business_unit tppbu ON (tp.position_id = tppbu.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_business_unit tbu ON (tppbu.bu_id = tbu.bu_id) LEFT JOIN tp_source_types tst ON (ts.source_type_id = tst.source_type_id) WHERE ta.applicant_id=? Group By tp.position_id

SELECT ta.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_city, ta.applicant_email1, ta.applicant_home_phone, ta.applicant_cell_phone, ta.applicant_work_phone, ta.applicant_date_created, ta.applicant_date_joined, tp.position_id, tp.position_date_expiry, tp.position_code, tp.position_title, ta.applicant_current_employer, tst.source_type as source_of_hire, ts.source_title as referred_by, CASE WHEN ts.employee_code is null THEN '' ELSE ts.employee_code END as referred_by_number, ta.offered_ctc, ta.applicant_level_offered as level_offered, ta.applicant_designation_offered as designation_offered, ta.applicant_notice_period as notice_period FROM tp_applicants ta LEFT JOIN tp_positions tp ON (ta.applicant_position_id = tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_sources ts ON (ts.source_id=ta.source_id) LEFT JOIN tp_source_types tst ON (tst.source_type_id=ts.source_type_id) WHERE ta.applicant_id=?
